original_sentence: "I'll be able to say 'Let's have pizza' to my family, my intelligent assistant will hear and 10 minutes later the food will be at my door."
translation: “我可以对家人说‘我们吃披萨吧’，我的智能助手会听到，10 分钟后食物就会送到我家门口。”

key_vocabulary.usage_note: be able to say 在本句中对应"能够说"。
10 minutes later 在本句中对应"十分钟后"。
at my door 在本句中对应"到我门口"。
intelligent assistant 在本句中对应"智能助手"。
